resources.string: Big cores limited to 1.77 GHz (the Battery Saver limit), GPU to 494 MHz.
Big cores limited to 2.18 GHz, small cores to 1.79 GHz, GPU to 585 MHz. Runs cooler for less power, with little everyday slowdown.
Stronger boosts when you touch the screen and open apps. Uses more battery.
Battery Saver still limits the CPU to 1.77 GHz and turns the extra Performance boosts off. Touch and app-launch boosts never go above the limits of the selected profile.
